extracted.summary: Prime Minister's Fellowship Scheme for Doctoral Research provides up to INR 10,41,000 annually to full‑time Ph.D. scholars in Science, Technology, Engineering, Agriculture or Medicine.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must have taken admission in a full-time Ph.D. degree in the last 14 months from the date of submission of applications in any recognized Indian University, Institute or Research Laboratory.
extracted.deadline_quote: Always Open. Last date for online submission of form is within 14 months from registration in the Ph.D.
